prompts.name: 03-calling-troop
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one landscape 16:9 film illustration for Chinese-school fable 猴子捞月. Reference image storyboard.png is STYLE AND CHARACTER reference only, not an edit target. Match its adorable fluffy natural brown monkeys, round tan faces, expressive dark eyes, finely textured rich painterly children's storybook style, mossy circular stone well, midnight-blue Chinese forest, jade foliage, golden moonlight. ONE full-bleed picture, no collage, panels, text, captions, bubbles, border or watermark. Supported coherent natural anatomy. Feet rest on dry ground, stone well rim, tree branch or are firmly held by another monkey; never on water. Keep essential actions and bodies safely inside the frame with generous margin. Scene: The little golden-brown monkey has just discovered the reflected moon and is calling the others. Show it standing on the broad stone well rim in foreground, one hand cupped beside its mouth as it shouts toward the forest. Its other hand points back down into the well at the clearly visible golden moon reflection. Three other distinct monkeys, a bigger chestnut adult, reddish youngster and gray-brown elder, hurry along the dry forest path toward it with concerned curious faces. The picture must show the action of CALLING and ARRIVING, distinct from the other gathered-at-the-well pictures.
